web.name: Still
web.description: A quiet room for migraine days.

plugins.microphonePermission: Still listens only while you hold the lamp or the dark screen, so you can say “softer” or “stop”. Speech is recognised on your phone; no audio leaves it.
Still listens only while you hold the lamp or the dark screen, so you can say “softer” or “stop”. Speech is recognised on your phone; no audio leaves it.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Still turns what you say into a command (like “softer” or “stop”) on your phone. No audio leaves it.

plugins.motionPermission: Only if you turn it on: Still reads air pressure on your phone, so a day with falling pressure can start your sound a little gentler. Nothing is sent.
